checks.description: Once their main base has fallen and nothing more is in sight, the Scout doctrine's army, when worth 10,000 or more, hunts the map sector by sector instead of standing at home. On hard-16-9, seed 300008 went from a 2,400s timeout to a win at 1,007s. Absent means the fight never reached that state (lost, or won while their base was still in sight), not necessarily that the branch is broken.

A hunter that sees one of their structures records it and asks for Attack, and the Scout doctrine goes straight to Attack rather than home through Opening (doctrine.scout-found-push). Absent under the same conditions as hunt-runs.

No fight may run past the benchmark's 2,400s limit. A timed-out benchmark game voids its pair, and three voided pairs stopped training outright. The three that did at the previous champion ended with 380 to 700 of our units at home and one or two enemy buildings never found.
The hunt changes only what the Scout doctrine's army does once it is big, so base assaults must still finish buildings. 22 were destroyed two fights ago; 8 is the component's reference.
